deltas.title_en: Law No. 2 of 2026 on Domestic Worker Protection (PPRT)
deltas.summary: New Indonesian law enacted 30 April 2026 establishing legal protections for domestic workers (Pekerja Rumah Tangga). Status: Berlaku (in force). 723 downloads from JDIH Kemnaker.
